name: Vernal-Dolina

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the west, an ancient meteor crater. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
For traders, platinum, aluminum, iron and silicon alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
